question: In 2025, how much monthly out-of-pocket allowance was approved for hockey players in the national camp by the Sports Ministry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹25,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Sports Ministry of India** approved a monthly out-of-pocket allowance of **₹25,000** for hockey players attending the **national camp** in 2025. This initiative emphasizes the importance of supporting the athletes financially.
 
• This decision was aimed at ensuring that players can meet their personal expenses while focusing entirely on their training and preparations for national and international events.
 
• The allowance is part of the government's ongoing efforts to promote **sports excellence** and provide adequate support to athletes representing the country.
 
• Hockey, as India's national sport, has received increasing attention in recent years, with the government focusing on providing better infrastructure, training facilities, and financial support to players.
 
• The initiative underscores the commitment of the Indian government to nurture talent and improve the performance of Indian hockey teams on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hockey in India:**

 
 
• **Hockey** is considered the **national sport of India** and has a rich history, with India winning multiple gold medals at the Olympics, especially during the mid-20th century.
 
• In recent years, Indian hockey has seen a resurgence with the **men's team winning a bronze medal** at the Tokyo Olympics 2021 and the women's team reaching the semi-finals.
 
• Hockey India is the governing body for the sport in India and works closely with the Sports Ministry and international federations.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Sports:**
 
 
• The government has launched several initiatives, such as **Khelo India** and **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)**, to support athletes in various sports, including hockey.
 
• **Khelo India** focuses on grassroots development and identifying young talent, while **TOPS** provides financial and infrastructural support to elite athletes.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Financial Support:**
 
 
• Providing financial allowances ensures that athletes can focus on their training without worrying about personal expenses, such as food, transportation, or medical needs.
 
• It also acts as a morale booster and recognizes the efforts of players representing the country at the highest levels.
 
 
 
• **Other Sports Supported:**
 
 
• While hockey is a priority, similar financial support is extended to athletes in other sports under various government schemes.
 
• This holistic approach aims to improve India's overall performance in global sporting events such as the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Support for National Camps:**

 
 
• National camps are organized to provide athletes with world-class coaching, facilities, and exposure to prepare for international tournaments.
 
• The camps include rigorous training sessions, fitness assessments, and strategy discussions to ensure peak performance.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Financial Allowances:**
 
 
• The ₹25,000 monthly allowance ensures that players can maintain a healthy lifestyle, which is crucial for their physical and mental well-being.
 
• It also allows players to invest in additional resources, such as nutritionists or physiotherapists, for enhanced performance.
 
 
 
• **Future of Indian Hockey:**
 
 
• With increased support and improved infrastructure, Indian hockey is poised to regain its dominance on the global stage.
 
• Continued government initiatives and private sponsorships are crucial for sustained success.
 
 

57:T
